name: Spadel S.a.
summary: Spadel S.a., de Participations, de Direction et d'Elaboration produces and markets natural mineral water in Belgium. It offers natural mineral water under the Spa, Bru, Wattwiller, Carola, Brecon Carreg, and Devin brand names. The company is based in Woluwé-Saint-Lambert, Belgium. Spadel S.a., de Participations, de Direction et d'Elaboration is a subsidiary of Finances Et Industries SA.
